crossRefs.note: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right…
When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head…
Each one went straight forward: where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are…

people.name: Chebar
people.line: River in Babylonia; location of Ezekiel's visions

translations.web: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.
translations.bsb: Their faces looked like the faces I had seen by the River Kebar. Each creature went straight ahead.
translations.kjv: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
translations.asv: And as for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves; they went every one straight forward.
